faq.q: Where do Ladner townhomes under $1.2M actually sit?
faq.a: On the page text read for this file, the feed's cards are labelled Holly, Hawthorne, Ladner Elementary and Neilsen Grove; on official sources, the City documents townhouse development at Marina Garden Estates, 5311 Admiral Way, in Neilsen Grove, and Ladner Village — the centre the central complexes surround — sits west of Chilukthan Slough per the Official Community Plan.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Ladner townhome?
faq.a: School District 37, address-based. For the sample address 5500 Admiral Boulevard the locator result is Neilson Grove Elementary (K–7) and Delta Secondary (8–12); Ladner's other elementaries include Hawthorne, Ladner Elementary and Port Guichon. Check the exact address in the SD37 School Locator — catchments are not assigned by complex name.

faq.q: What flood questions should I ask on a Ladner townhome?
faq.a: Whether the complex is within 30 m of a stream, slough or ditch (the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area), and how the strata's depreciation report and insurance treat Ladner's setting behind the City's flood-protection system — over 63 km of dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection, 31 drainage pump stations and about 538 km of drainage infrastructure.
